params.prompt: Full-body character design: a small, low, wide creature, a soot-black crab that lives inside a dented copper coal scuttle, the bucket worn on its back as a shell with the slanted pouring lip forward like a visor and the hoop handle folded back. Two glowing ember-orange eyes on short stalks peer out from under the lip. Six stubby jointed legs. Its left claw is small; its right claw is oversized and shaped like a pair of blacksmith's iron fire tongs. A few lumps of coal sit in the scuttle behind its head, one faintly glowing. Cheeky, alert expression. Three-quarter front view, crouched low on the ground with the big claw raised. Chunky stylised proportions, clean readable shapes, hand-painted look, an original character for a stylised 3D video game set in a mountain forge town. Soft even studio lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no cast shadows.
